notes.title: Mini Mecum: The Final Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259955/d21f6e7b14e687540e72a158117b2b7381f52356.png[/img]

[b]Kept y'all waiting on this one, sorry about that.[/b]

I had never planned to come back to Mini Mecum. I made it, I was okay with it, and I was done with it. But I wasn't really proud of it, either. Now, with the skills I have, I felt pretty bad releasing it in the state it was, even if people liked it. Especially because people liked it. 

I don't know where the appeal lies, so I didn't mess with the writing, but I've done a pretty comprehensive overhaul to bring the rest of the game to my new standards. If you've played the game already, I'd honestly recommend you do again. It's very different.

Enjoy!

[h1]CHANGELOG:[/h1]
[h2]Overhauls:[/h2]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*]Overhauled the shader styles one more time to better compliment flat textures
[*]Added textures to most areas to support lighting and depth (carpets, office rooms, ETC)
[*]Completely redid the office lobby and hallway zones to better set an aesthetic
[*]Remodelled the airship to look more Airshippy.
[*]Remodelled/Shaded the end vortex.
[*]Removed all instances of the blob noise patter.
[*]Improved shadow rendering across the board.
[*]Updated the office garden, as well as skybox.
[*]Replaced the black/white office room.
[*]Added particles to places that needed them (ocean splashes, waterfall, engines)
[*]Redid the scream painting area.
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redid the music transition system to prevent unpleasant clips and jumps
[*] Added a variety of new tracks in the Airship, office, and end zones.
[*] Added special chiptune variants of music for OOB areas
[*] Retouched music for the beach and museum areas.
[/list]
[h3]QOL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mecumites now have text bubbles to make reading easier.
[*] Game now significantly more performant in high-stress areas (office, portals)
[*] Added a Settings menu with volume, sensitivity, and Resolution
[*] Added an option to delete save file.
[/list]
[h2]BUGS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the end area was inaccessible
[*] Fixed a variety of issues with player portal interactions
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could use items when in menus
[*] Fixed an issue where environments were missing collision
[*] Fixed multiple areas in which the player could jump out of bounds
[*] Fixed an issue where credits wouldn't trigger in void
[*] Fixed an issue where audio would improperly load in new scenes, giving away transitions
[*] Fixed an issue where sound effects would play in pause menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where some held items would glitch out on hold
[*] Fixed an issue where npc dialogue failed to load
[/list]

Also: I've started a new, bigger game! One more game-like as well. I don't have much to give on it yet, but keep peeled. here's a little teaser:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259955/2fd4977b4de5904cceea12132ebb9ec853c97c1c.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the beach ball was missing textures.

notes.title: Mini Mecum Overhaul!
notes.notes:
[b]Over the past few months I've worked on redrawing pretty much every sprite in the game to fit a higher standard of quality, and it's finally done! For the next week, the project will be in a beta for the new content, but when it's ready, the game will go on sale with the new content![/b]

To access, right click on the game - > properties - > type in "SuperMecumSecret" and select the new beta to see it

[b]Changes:[/b]
-Fixed portal rendering to prevent launches into the sun
-Fixed an issue where some sprites would glitch between variations
-Updated Lighting across the game
-Improved the quality of glass
-Mecum'd the paintings
-Added foliage
-Improved performance in the museum
-Updated the soundtrack in a few areas
-added a new npc or two :)
-fixed an issue where trees wouldn't cull at the proper distance
-added save support for specific things.
-fixed an issue where the player couldn't interact with specific items
-fixed an issue where the player was short
-fixed an issue where portals would occasionally spit players out at a wrong angle
-fixed an issue where the soundtrack wasn't available for sale (it will be)
-fixed an issue where terrain textures blended ugly
-fixed a clipping issue with the waterfall
-improved drowning
-redrew every sprite in the game 
-improved the pause screen to match scale

notes.title: Mini Mecum UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]A new update is now out for Mini Mecum![/b][/h1]
Thank you so much to everyone who's played, downloaded, and shared mini mecum! After a brief period of a lot of sleep, I've released a new update, featuring bugfixes, improvements, and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259955/a8cdecbf7bcac93058fd9cf066dbb3d0c3dfaa19.png[/img]
[h2]Pause Menu![/h2]
You can pause the game now! and if you softlock, a handy "stuck" button will put you back at the elevator!
[h2]Lighting Improvements![/h2]
All the lighting in the game has been drastically improved, optimized, and generally made better in every way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259955/661f4d59cd2a32fc377fbe9e794451b7a6af8ea3.png[/img]
[h2]Bugfixes![/h2]
-Fixed an issue where office elevators would teleport you out of bounds if you were outside
-Fixed issues where players could fall forever
-Added a new NPC
-Fixed an issue where lighting was failing to display
-Fixed(?) an issue where vertical portals would fail to work occasionally
-Fixed an issue where lights would clip through terrain
-Improved some NPC sprites to have better positioning
-Fixed a minor issue where sand would show through the elevator
-Fixed a minor issue with shader optimization
-Left in some funny bugs.
